Company description: AXP (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

American Express Company, trading under the ticker AXP, is a globally integrated payments company that provides customers with access to products, insights, and experiences that enrich lives and build business success. Founded in 1850 as an express mail transportation business in Buffalo, New York, the company evolved through the late 19th and 20th centuries to become a pioneer in financial services, issuing its first paper charge card in 1958 and subsequently launching corporate travel services. Today, American Express primarily operates through its credit card, charge card, and travel-related services, functioning both as an issuer and a payment network. Its core business model generates revenue primarily through discount revenue from merchant transactions, cardmember fees, and net interest income from lending activities. Serving a worldwide customer base ranging from consumers to small businesses and large corporations, American Express maintains a strong reputation for premium customer service, loyalty rewards programs, and secure payment processing.
